claims.author: winterrdog
claims.harm: Removing ReadRequest and inlining into TryReadRequestInternal duplicates buffer cleanup across each catch block, risking cleanup omission when adding future error cases
claims.quote: ReadRequest gave us one place to clean up `m_recv_buffer` after a failed parse. now, each `catch` block has to remember to do that itself, so it is easy for someone adding a new error case later to forget.

status_by.quote: Could potentially add an inner `try`/`catch`-block... Would prefer doing that over bringing back `HTTPRemoteClient::ReadRequest()`. WDYT?

claims.status_note: author proposed an inner try/catch block to consolidate cleanup instead of restoring ReadRequest, waiting for winterrdog's response
